feeds.title: Fintech News Switzerland
feeds.description: Launched in 2014, Fintech News Switzerland provides a source of timely, deep insights and the latest local and global news about Fintech. Fintech News Network team works very hard to deliver fintech-centric content in various forms to an audience looking for updates on fintech events and webinars.

feeds.title: Loanboox Switzerland Blog
feeds.description: Are you interested in the Fintech world? Or would you like to find out about developments in the debt capital markets? This is the right place for you. Loanboox is the leading European provider for debt financing and management. Our mission is to make debt capital markets fair & efficient, across borders.

feeds.title: LEXR Blog
feeds.description: Blog for legal solutions for entrepreneurs by LEXR - a Zurich-based legal services company for tech, fintech & digital companies. We are a legal services company focused on tech, fintech, and digital businesses. As entrepreneurs ourselves, we understand the obstacles companies face, and we don't want legal to be one of them.

feeds.title: Additiv
feeds.description: Established in 1998, additiv partners with leading companies across the world to help them capitalize on the possibilities of embedded wealth, enabling financial institutions to access new distribution channels through a Banking-as-a-Service model. Stay up to date with the latest fintech and wealthtech news and announcements, from the leading Swiss WealthTech company, additiv.

feeds.title: FintechSetup
feeds.description: FintechSetup is your One Stop Services Partner of savvy fintech creators. The company was established in Hong Kong in 2002 as a boutique comprehensive business advisory platform. From 2010 we also started focusing our practice on Fintech related investments.

feeds.title: Swiss Fintech Innovations
feeds.description: Get to know the latest news on fintech from Swiss Fintech Innovations. We are an independent association of Swiss financial institutes committed to drive collaboration and digital innovations in the financial services industry. We strengthen the Fintech ecosystem in Switzerland by involving relevant partners, support Fintech Events and Initiatives - connecting the dots.
